Nodes.metaDescription: The CSI node model: geographic expansion across Puebla through reciprocal collaboration. Anchor nodes active in Tehuacán and Huejotzingo.
Nodes.introDescription: Nodes extend cluster activity beyond the Hub, bringing programs, talent and projects to different regions of the state.
Nodes.pillarModelDesc: Each node operates as a local extension of the cluster: it convenes actors in its region, spreads programs and feeds projects into the state ecosystem.
Nodes.pillarReciprocityDesc: During the first year there are no monetary transfers: collaboration is built on resources, talent, spaces and infrastructure contributed by each party.
Nodes.mapDescription: The cluster's first nodes operate as regional reference points for the rest of Puebla.
Nodes.mapImageAlt: Map of CSI nodes in the state of Puebla
Nodes.tehuacanDesc: Anchor node for the southern region, with projects linked to local industry and regional talent.
Nodes.huejotzingoDesc: Anchor node for the western region, connected to the state's industrial and logistics corridor.
Nodes.ctaTitle: Propose a node in your region
Nodes.ctaDescription: If an institution or actor outside the metro area wants to drive a cluster node in its region, work with us to build a new node.
